'''Iain Sarkus''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a young member of the [[Hawkeyes]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]], Iain was a reluctant agent of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] until he defected to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and helped the Resistance on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] crack down the Imperial satellite defense system.
